description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating six 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Astartes Warriors, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
